tools.name: kafka_acl_manage
tools.description: Inspect and reconcile live Kafka ACLs. Read-only actions (list, audit, diff, dry_run) read live broker ACLs against a caller-supplied desired state. Reconciling actions (apply, reconcile) create missing and delete obsolete exact ACLs on the broker and require an approval grant. Stateless: no desired state is stored server-side.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action: list, audit, diff, dry_run, apply, reconcile

parameters.name: principal
parameters.description: Principal filter or default principal for supplied rules (e.g. User:app1)

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Resource type filter for list/audit: topic, group, cluster, transactional_id

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: Desired ACL rules array (for diff, dry_run, apply, reconcile). Each rule: {principal, host, resource_type, resource_name, pattern_type, operation, permission}

parameters.name: approval_token
parameters.description: Short-lived token issued by kafka_approval for this exact request.

tools.name: kafka_alter_topic
tools.description: Modify configuration of an existing Kafka topic.

parameters.name: approval_token
parameters.description: Short-lived token issued by kafka_approval for this exact request.

tools.name: kafka_analyze_dlq
tools.description: Analyze a dead-letter queue topic: consume recent messages, parse error headers, categorize failure types, and return a statistical summary with samples.

tools.name: kafka_approval
tools.description: Manage identity-bound, short-lived approval grants for ops-write tools. Grants are two-person by default, single-use, argument-scoped, persisted when SQLite is enabled, and recorded in a tamper-evident decision chain.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: request | approve | list | get | revoke | status

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Target write tool (for request), e.g. kafka_delete_topic

parameters.name: request_reason
parameters.description: Why the mutation is needed (for request)

parameters.name: ttl_seconds
parameters.description: Requested grant lifetime in seconds (for approve); capped by config

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Optional agent filter for list (admin only)

tools.name: kafka_check_schema_compatibility
tools.description: Check if a proposed schema is compatible with the subject's compatibility policy.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The proposed schema definition as a JSON string

parameters.name: schema_type
parameters.description: Schema type: AVRO, PROTOBUF, JSON. Default: AVRO

tools.name: kafka_consume
tools.description: Read messages from a Kafka topic with flexible positioning. Supports earliest, latest, numeric offset, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: Specific partition (-1 for all). Default: all

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start position: 'earliest', 'latest', numeric offset, or ISO 8601 timestamp. Default: 'latest'

parameters.name: deserializer
parameters.description: Deserialization format: auto, json, string, bytes. Auto tries JSON and falls back to string.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Maximum wait time in ms. Default: 5000
